mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening economy, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS shows a sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (proxied by INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which positively impacts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (proxied by PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand side, which positively impacts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both proxies show a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a potential deflationary pressure, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 50,000 in a month signals a significant weakening in the labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases & PAYEMS decreases > 50,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both conditions are met.
